ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white/light grey) to 25% low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Contiguous low-intensity region along the posterior trailing edge with 7-9 vertical linear extensions (rake marks) towards the anterior. Right lobe: Primarily high-intensity white with sparse, thin dark radial streaks concentrated near the notch and trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with an approximate pixel angle of 115 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency micro-serrations observed along the entire trailing boundary; the left lobe displays more irregular, jagged peak-to-valley variations compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe exhibits a broad convex curve ending in a rounded tip; right lobe presents a more elongated, shallow convex sweep tapering to a narrower distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 6-8 parallel, vertically-oriented dark linear streaks are prominent on the medial-posterior section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel rake marks on the left lobe and irregular jagged material loss along the posterior trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: The dark linear markings on the left lobe exhibit a distinctive wavy or oscillating pixel pattern.
